You can book a tour of the brewery to hear some brewing secrets and sample different varieties of craft beer, guided by the brewer’s recommendations. Relax in our hot tub, enjoy a traditional “leil” in the sauna, and simply listen to birdsong. By the way, did you know that Käblik, the name of our farm and holiday houses, is the Estonian word for the Eurasian wren – a tiny forest bird with a loud voice, but rarely seen? Käbliku Holiday Houses a place to spot them! At Käbliku Holiday Houses, you can escape the rush of everyday life, embrace the power of slowing down, and experience nature’s tranquillity.
